title: Implement mean-field model and compute phase diagram
action: Implement the short-range structural model of W(001) reconstruction coupled to a hydrogen lattice gas. Solve the mean-field self-consistency equations to obtain coverage- and temperature-dependent order parameters and free energies. Produce a function that maps model parameters (ΔE, f) and coverage to the nearest transition temperature.
description: Evidence that the mean-field model was implemented and run; contains intermediate outputs and convergence information.

title: Fit interaction constants to experimental data
action: Using the implemented model and the provided experimental phase diagram data (exp_phase_diagram.csv), perform a nonlinear least-squares fit to determine the energy difference ΔE (eV/atom) and the force constant f (eV/u0). Write the best-fit values to constants.json.
description: JSON file containing the two fitted interaction constants.
